top_story_comment: Eight-way weighted Snapshot using Leviathan’s `SQUID-vote` API strategy on Fraxtal means this Drop is budget routing, not a vanilla bagholder poll. The May split is the pressure point: 929 human-curated posts against 6,743 Tsunami ingests, so overpaying raw activity trains farms while underpaying curation lets agents become the product. I’d push weight toward News/Moderation/Dev that compounds the data layer, then let Treasury absorb the low-signal remainder.
